gen-righteous-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads openly, every curve left ajar. Righteous is the showier one, a bent-rod display face that fills its line, while the plain sans body keeps capitals and lowercase nearly level.
gen-righteous-gf-chivo: Chivo packs its lowercase up toward the capitals, with daylight showing through every curve. And over a long page, that tight, open texture would keep moving smoothly beside Righteous, whose marker-like strokes stay bold up top.
gen-righteous-gf-chocolate-classical-san: Chocolate Classical Sans has a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut beside Righteous. Chocolate Classical Sans would carry a long passage comfortably, with a modern, unfussy feel.
gen-righteous-gf-comme: Smooth and modern, with nothing clogged. And Righteous, whose letter parts carry matching visual mass, looks best large, while Comme's lowercase bodies fill most of the letter height below it.
gen-righteous-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte has wide-eyed lowercase e shapes, n arches as thick as their stems, and a prominent x-height. Righteous leads; give the Cossette Texte text a bit more size.
gen-righteous-gf-duru-sans: Rounded and pipe-cleaner thin up top. And Duru Sans, a plain sans with wide openings on small letters, lets its bodies dominate the line, so a long read feels steady below Righteous.
gen-righteous-gf-fresca: Fun and commanding up top, with Righteous bowls filling the line over Fresca's short ascenders and connected counters. Fresca's lack of calligraphic thinning is its strongest card.
gen-righteous-gf-funnel-sans: Righteous brings bowls that fill the line and a thin bent-rod build, a loud opener. And Funnel Sans, sans-serif with a pried-clasp lowercase e, would look good at a modest text size beneath it.
gen-righteous-gf-gafata: Chunky, rod-like display letters, bowls filling the line. Righteous has stroke contrast of exactly none and earns its keep big and short, while Gafata's tall band of letters and short stalks stay below.
gen-righteous-gf-geist: Geist reads in a quiet, level beat, with no accents of weight and words that form solid blocks rather than skylines. Over a long page it would hum along quietly beneath Righteous.
